Prealgebra · Lesson 9.2

A Percent of a Number

Solve this lesson →All lessons

Part = percent × whole. The word "of" between a percent and a number means multiply. A jacket at 25%25% off, a tip at 18%18%, a poll where 60%60% agree, all of them come down to that one multiplication.

Problem
A wildlife reserve counts 200200 nesting birds, and 25%25% are herons. How many herons are there?
Show a hint
  • The word "of" means multiply. Rewrite 25%25% as 1441​ or 0.250.25, then multiply it by 200200.
  • One quarter of 200200 is 200÷4=50200÷4=50. Or 0.25×200=500.25×200=50.
Show the full solution
25%=1425%=41​, and "of" means multiply, so 25% of 200=14×200=50.25% of 200=41​×200=50. There are 5050​ herons. Decimals work just as well, 0.25×200=500.25×200=50.
Problem
A bakery sold 3535 loaves, and 60%60% were sourdough. How many sourdough loaves were sold?
Show a hint
  • Rewrite 60%60% as 0.60.6 (or 3553​), then multiply by 3535.
  • 0.6×35=210.6×35=21. Or 35×35=3×7=2153​×35=3×7=21.
Show the full solution
Convert and multiply. Since 60%=35=0.660%=53​=0.6, 60% of 35=35×35=3×7=21.60% of 35=53​×35=3×7=21. So 2121​ sourdough loaves were sold.
Problem
A startup had 1515 employees and grew to 300%300% of that size. How many employees are there now?
Show a hint
  • A percent over 100100 becomes a number bigger than 11. Here 300%=3300%=3.
  • Multiply 3×15=453×15=45.
Show the full solution
300%=300100=3300%=100300​=3, so 300% of 15=3×15=45.300% of 15=3×15=45. There are 4545​ employees. A percent above 100100 gives more than the whole, so an answer larger than 1515 is the right sign.
Key idea
"Of" means multiply. To find a percent of a number, write the percent as a fraction or a decimal and multiply, since the word "of" between a percent and a number means times. This is part == percent ×× whole. The multiplier also checks your answer, since taking 100%100% leaves a number unchanged, taking less than 100%100% makes it smaller, and taking more than 100%100% makes it larger.
Problem
A theater holds 6464 seats, and 1212%1221​% are reserved for staff. Since 1212%=181221​%=81​, how many seats are reserved?
Show a hint
  • First convert. 1212%=12.5%=12.5100=181221​%=12.5%=10012.5​=81​.
  • One eighth of 6464 is 64÷8=864÷8=8.
Show the full solution
Convert the fractional percent to a clean fraction, 1212%=12.5100=181221​%=10012.5​=81​. Then 1212% of 64=18×64=8.1221​% of 64=81​×64=8. So 88​ seats are reserved.
Problem
A water sample weighs 8080 g, and 2.5%2.5% is dissolved minerals. How many grams of minerals are there?
Show a hint
  • Slide the point two places left, so 2.5%=0.0252.5%=0.025.
  • 0.025×80=20.025×80=2.
Show the full solution
Convert the percent to a decimal by sliding the point two places left, 2.5%=0.0252.5%=0.025. Then 2.5% of 80=0.025×80=2.2.5% of 80=0.025×80=2. So there are 22​ grams of dissolved minerals.
Problem
A class read 3030 books out of a goal of 120120. What percent of the goal did they reach? Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • Make the fraction part over whole, 3012012030​, and simplify.
  • 30120=14=0.2512030​=41​=0.25, and 0.250.25 as a percent is 25%25%.
Show the full solution
Divide the part by the whole, then write it as a percent. 30120=14=0.25=25%.12030​=41​=0.25=25%. So 3030 is 2525​ percent of 120120.
Problem
A phone battery holds 8080 units full and 6060 units now. What percent of 8080 is 6060? Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • The part is 6060 and the whole is 8080, so form 60808060​ and simplify.
  • 6080=34=0.75=75%8060​=43​=0.75=75%.
Show the full solution
Divide the part by the whole, then convert to a percent. 6080=34=0.75=75%.8060​=43​=0.75=75%. So 6060 is 7575​ percent of 8080.
Problem
A shop bought a desk for $17$17 and resold it for $51$51. What percent is 5151 of 1717? Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • Form 51171751​. Since 5151 is bigger than 1717, expect a percent above 100100.
  • 5117=3=300%1751​=3=300%.
Show the full solution
Divide the part by the whole, 5117=31751​=3, and 3=300%3=300%. So 5151 is 300300​ percent of 1717. The resale price is three times the cost, which is what a percent above 100100 always means.
Key idea
Percent == part ÷÷ whole. To find what percent one number is of another, divide the part by the whole and write the result as a percent. This is the same relationship as before, rearranged to solve for the percent instead of the part.
Problem
A scholarship covers $80$80 of a fee, and that is exactly 20%20% of the full fee. 8080 is 20%20% of what number?
Show a hint
  • The relationship is part equals percent times whole, so whole equals part divided by percent. Use 20%=0.220%=0.2.
  • 80÷0.2=40080÷0.2=400. Check, 20%20% of 400400 is 8080.
Show the full solution
With 20%=0.220%=0.2, divide the part by the percent, whole=800.2=400.whole=0.280​=400. So 8080 is 20%20% of 400400​. Check by going forward, 0.2×400=800.2×400=80.
Problem
A hiker has walked 2727 km, which is 75%75% of the full trail. 2727 is 75%75% of what number?
Show a hint
  • Whole equals part divided by percent, so compute 27÷0.7527÷0.75.
  • 27÷34=27×43=3627÷43​=27×34​=36. Check, 75%75% of 3636 is 2727.
Show the full solution
Divide the part by the percent. With 75%=3475%=43​, whole=27÷34=27×43=36.whole=27÷43​=27×34​=36. The trail is 3636​ kilometers long. Check by going forward, 34×36=2743​×36=27.
Key idea
Whole == part ÷÷ percent. When you know the part and the percent but not the whole, divide the part by the percent. Write the percent as a fraction or a decimal first. This undoes the multiplication, so check by taking that percent of your answer and seeing if you get the part back.
Fun fact
Ancient Rome funded its army with a 1%1% levy on public auctions. Counting in hundredths made tax rates easy to compare and collect, the same reason a percent is handy today.
Problem
A startup's revenue this month is $18$18k, which is 150%150% of last month's. 1818 is 150%150% of what number?
Show a hint
  • Whole equals part divided by percent, so compute 18÷1.518÷1.5.
  • 18÷1.5=1218÷1.5=12. Since the percent is over 100100, the whole is smaller than the part.
Show the full solution
Divide the part by the percent, with 150%=1.5150%=1.5. whole=181.5=12.whole=1.518​=12. Last month's revenue was 1212​ thousand dollars. Since 150%150% is more than 100%100%, the whole comes out smaller than the part, and 1212 is indeed under 1818.
Problem
A museum finds 30%30% of 8080 visitors came by bus. What percent of 120120 school visitors is that same bus count? Give just the number.
Show a hint
  • Step one, find 30%30% of 8080. That is 0.3×80=240.3×80=24.
  • Step two, what percent is 2424 of 120120? Form 24120=0.2=20%12024​=0.2=20%.
Show the full solution
Do it in two steps. First the part, 30%30% of 80=0.3×80=2480=0.3×80=24. Then ask what percent 2424 is of 120120, 24120=15=0.2=20%.12024​=51​=0.2=20%. So 30%30% of 8080 is 2020​ percent of 120120.

Practice these ideas

Practice
A farmers market had 9090 stalls, and 40%40% sold vegetables. How many stalls sold vegetables?
Show the solution
40%=0.440%=0.4, so 40% of 90=0.4×90=3640% of 90=0.4×90=36. So 3636​ stalls sold vegetables.
Practice
A song had 1212 thousand listeners last week and climbed to 250%250% of that this week. How many thousand listeners this week?
Show the solution
250%=250100=2.5250%=100250​=2.5, so 250% of 12=2.5×12=30250% of 12=2.5×12=30. So there are 3030​ thousand listeners.
Practice
A puzzle has 1616 pieces, and 3712%3721​% are edge pieces. How many edge pieces are there?
Show the solution
3712%=37.5100=383721​%=10037.5​=83​, so 38×16=683​×16=6. So there are 66​ edge pieces.
Practice
A reservoir holds 150150 million liters, and 8%8% is in reserve. How many million liters are in reserve?
Show the solution
8%=0.088%=0.08, so 8% of 150=0.08×150=128% of 150=0.08×150=12. So 1212​ million liters are in reserve.
Practice
A team won 1818 of its 7272 games. What percent did the team win? Give just the number.
Show the solution
1872=14=0.25=25%7218​=41​=0.25=25%. So the team won 2525​ percent of its games.
Practice
A jar holds 4040 marbles and 3030 are blue. What percent of 4040 is 3030? Give just the number.
Show the solution
3040=34=0.75=75%4030​=43​=0.75=75%. So 3030 is 7575​ percent of 4040.
Practice
A sequel sold 8484 thousand copies. The original sold 5656 thousand. What percent is 8484 of 5656? Give just the number.
Show the solution
8456=32=1.5=150%5684​=23​=1.5=150%. So 8484 is 150150​ percent of 5656.
Practice
A deposit of $21$21 is 30%30% of a bike's total price. 2121 is 30%30% of what number?
Show the solution
With 30%=0.330%=0.3, divide the part by the percent, 210.3=700.321​=70. The price is 7070​ dollars. Check by going forward, 0.3×70=210.3×70=21.
Practice
A runner has finished 4545 laps, which is 90%90% of the race. 4545 is 90%90% of what number?
Show the solution
With 90%=0.990%=0.9, divide the part by the percent, 450.9=500.945​=50. The race is 5050​ laps. Check by going forward, 0.9×50=450.9×50=45.
Practice
This year a town recorded 120120 building permits, which is 150%150% of last year's. 120120 is 150%150% of what number?
Show the solution
With 150%=1.5150%=1.5, divide the part by the percent, 1201.5=801.5120​=80. Last year had 8080​ permits. Check by going forward, 1.5×80=1201.5×80=120.
Practice
A tasting portion is 55 g, which is 1212%1221​% of a full serving. 55 is 1212%1221​% of what number?
Show the solution
1212%=181221​%=81​, and the whole is the part divided by the percent, so 5÷18=5×8=405÷81​=5×8=40. A full serving is 4040​ grams. Check by going forward, 18×40=581​×40=5.
Practice
Chain two steps. Take 60%60% of 500500, then take 20%20% of that result. What is 20%20% of 60%60% of 500500?
Show the solution
Work from the inside out. First 60%60% of 500=0.6×500=300500=0.6×500=300. Then 20%20% of 300=0.2×300=60300=0.2×300=60. So 20%20% of 60%60% of 500500 is 6060​.
